themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents capable of performing complex research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including planning, execution, and artifact creation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, reviewing, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles covering specific AI-powered platforms, software, or functionalities designed to aid in various research processes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for easier understanding.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is integrated into the design process, from ideation and prototyping to UX analysis and visual creation.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussions on how AI is affecting jobs, skill requirements, recruitment, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that review, compare, or assess the effectiveness and utility of specific AI tools for UX and research.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content related to the creation and use of artificial or simulated user data and personas for research and testing.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Discussions on how AI tools and techniques are being applied to enhance product discovery, development, and lifecycle management.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI's capability to analyze large datasets, extract insights, and identify patterns for research and business intelligence.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
